scope: Read-only launch diagnosis; tiny owned AppKit app had no windows, no model/API/Keychain access. The standard descriptor is non-secret and was read only; no descriptor content was saved.
initialResult: Foundation and tiny LaunchServices probes do not reproduce environment caching or lost Swift/C projection. This does not supersede the real installed-app failure.
nativeNotes: Initial tiny compile defaulted to macOS28 deployment target; LaunchServices rejected with -10825. Target14 was then explicit.
Synthetic and standard-choice AppKit probes exited normally with status0 and own app process terminated.
Installed app _main disassembly begins with a call to DesktopConnectionBootstrap.install; source list includes both entrypoint and bootstrap.
